summary: The proof passes sequential verification. The statement is self-contained, and no hard-prohibition violations occur. Step 2 correctly establishes flatness, henselianity, the completed cotangent splitting, and the p-power bounds on its derived exterior-power errors. Step 3 correctly uses connectivity and equivariant Postnikov towers to obtain the absolute-to-relative cyclic comparison without requiring a uniform bound over all degrees. The continuity and relative K-theory inputs have the asserted hypotheses and completion conventions in [AMMN](https://arxiv.org/html/2003.12541v2); the HKR filtration is supported by [Antieau, Sections 3–4](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.05246#S4). Step 4's factorial-scaled mixed-complex map, cone amplitude, and uniform equivariant annihilation justify all three cyclic totalizations for arbitrary p. Their finite number of summands in each degree justifies termwise completion and ordinary algebraic homology, consistently with [Bökstedt–Ottosen, Section 2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1601.07412v2) and [Hoyois, Theorems 2.1 and 2.3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1506.07123v2). Step 5 correctly replaces reduction modulo p by reduction modulo pi using nilpotent invariance after completion and inversion. Step 6 establishes module compatibility for the specific AMMN constructions, using the norm and multiplicativity structures of [Nikolaus–Scholze](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.01799) and [Blumberg–Gepner–Tabuada](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1103.3923). Naturality is independent of the auxiliary splitting. No finite-presentation condition on the localization or inequality between p and d_rel is introduced.
